argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const username = ('{{ user }}' || '').replace(/^@/, ''); const limit = {{ limit }} || 50; const ct0 = document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('ct0='))?.split('=')[1]; if (!ct0) return { error: 'Not logged into x.com (no ct0 cookie)' }; await new Promise(r => { const start = Date.now(); const poll = () => { const cells = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="UserCell"]'); if (cells.length > 0) return r(); if (Date.now() - start > 8000) return r(); setTimeout(poll, 500); }; poll(); }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const items = []; const seen = new Set(); const cells = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="UserCell"]'); for (const cell of cells) { if (items.length >= limit) break; let screenName = ''; const links = cell.querySelectorAll('a[href]'); for (const link of links) { const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (href.startsWith('/') && !href.startsWith('/i/') && href.split('/').length === 2 && href !== '/home' && href !== '/explore' && href !== '/notifications' && href !== '/messages') { screenName = href.replace(/^\//, ''); break; } } if (!screenName || seen.has(screenName)) continue; seen.add(screenName); const textLines = (cell.textContent || '').split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean); for (const l of textLines) { if (l.startsWith('@')) textLines.splice(textLines.indexOf(l), 1); } const name = textLines[0] || ''; const bio = textLines.slice(1).join(' ').replace(/\@\w+/g, '').replace(/Following|Follows you|Follow/g, '').trim(); items.push({ screen_name: screenName, name, bio }); } return { results: items }; }
async (intermediate) => { if (intermediate.error) return [{ screen_name: '', name: '', bio: '', error: intermediate.error }]; return intermediate.results || []; }
